clips.title: The story
paras: Around Thunder Bluff, prairie wolf alphas roam Mulgore’s open plains. Mull Thunderhorn needs their teeth to cleanse the Wildmane Well.

Mulgore’s wells sustain the tauren, and keeping them pure calls for rites of respect and sacrifice. Mull Thunderhorn of Bloodhoof Village needs teeth from the prairie wolf alphas that prowl beneath Thunder Bluff to cleanse the Wildmane Well. These fierce pack leaders embody the strength of the wild. Their teeth honor the balance between hunter, prey, and the spirits of the earth.
